info.title: BrightPath API
info.description:
Backend API for BrightPath: NEET rank predictor, college finder and student enquiries.

This spec is the contract for the frontend. Every route documents its summary, parameters, request body and responses. Exported to `docs/openapi.json` via `bun run openapi:export`.

**Errors.** Every non-2xx response uses one body shape, `{ error: { code, message, fields?, requestId } }`. `fields` lists per-field problems for form validation (HTTP 422). `requestId` matches the `X-Request-Id` header.

**Empty query values.** A query parameter sent with an empty value (`?limit=`) is treated as not provided.

**Rate limits.** Public routes are limited per IP. When exceeded the API answers 429 with a `Retry-After` header.

**Staff auth.** `/admin/*` routes need a staff session: `POST /admin/auth/login` sets an httpOnly `bp_session` cookie; send requests with credentials. Writes must also send `X-BP-Admin: 1`. Roles: ADMIN (everything), EDITOR (content and data), COUNSELLOR (enquiries). 401 = not logged in, 403 = not allowed.

**Changelog.** 0.8.0: bulk upload (`/admin/imports`): upload an Excel or CSV file of colleges or of fees, get a row-by-row preview, then save it in one step or discard it. CSV templates at `/admin/imports/templates/{kind}`. 0.7.0: exchange rates (`/admin/fx-rates`): one rate per currency, set singly or in bulk; changing a rate recalculates the rupee total of every college using that currency in the same step; a change of more than 20% needs `confirmLargeChange`; a rate cannot be removed while a live college uses it. 0.6.0: college catalogue admin (`/admin/colleges`): create colleges as drafts, edit details, inline fee table (one row per course year, `PUT /admin/colleges/{id}/fees/{year}`), source links, FAQs, and the status actions Mark ready / Move to draft / Archive. Mark ready is refused with 422 and a list of every missing detail until the college is complete; a live college cannot be edited into an incomplete state. NMC notices can now be college-level (`scope` COLLEGE + `collegeId`). 0.5.2: validation errors now name the right field for out-of-range numbers (was `(body)`; unnamed cases are `(request)`) and say what is allowed ("Enter a whole number from -180 to 720.") instead of "Expected union value"; `GET /neet/rank` answers 404 with error code `NOT_PUBLISHED_YET` while no year is published (a year that is not available is still 422 on `year`). 0.5.1: a locked staff account now answers 429 with error code `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` (was `RATE_LIMITED`); a refused setting value now explains what is allowed. 0.5.0: NEET rank predictor (`GET /neet/rank`, `GET /neet/data-sources`) and NEET data admin (years, cut-offs, score-count upload, preview, publish). 0.4.0: reference data admin (states, countries, sources, NMC notices). 0.3.1: blank query parameters are treated as not provided. 0.3.0: staff login/roles, staff management, site settings, versioned disclaimers, audit log, `GET /site/config`. 0.2.0: foundation (error envelope, request ids, rate limiting, security headers).

get.summary: Predict NEET (UG) rank from a score
get.description:
Turns a NEET (UG) score into an All-India rank **range** using the official NTA result data. The same score always gives the same answer (`tableVersion` identifies the exact table used). Ranks are ranges because tied students share a band of ranks.

- `result.outcome` is `BELOW_CUTOFF` when the score is under the qualifying cut-off; rank fields are then null.
- `result.outcome` is `NOT_PUBLISHED_BY_NTA` when NTA published no score counts for that year (only totals and cut-offs); rank fields are null, `qualification` is still given, and the explanation says why. Show that message instead of a rank.
- `result.approximate` is true when the year's data only has counts per mark range; show the estimate as approximate and mention `possibleRankSpan`.
- `categoryRank` / `pwdRank` are null when the year's data does not support them (never guessed).
- `otherYears` gives the same score in every other published year (for "same score in the other year").
- `meta.disclaimer` must be shown with the answer.

Supports `ETag` / `If-None-Match`. While no year is published at all the answer is 404 with error code `NOT_PUBLISHED_YET` (whatever `year` is sent; show "rank predictor coming soon"). Once a year is published, 422 with a `year` field error means that year is not available, and 422 on `score` means it is outside -180..720.

post.description: Starts a staff session and sets the `bp_session` cookie (httpOnly, SameSite=Lax, Secure in production). Wrong email and wrong password give the same 401 message. After 5 wrong passwords the account is locked for 15 minutes: further attempts, even with the right password, answer 429 with error code `ACCOUNT_LOCKED` and a `Retry-After` header. Separately, more than 10 attempts per minute from one IP answer 429 with code `RATE_LIMITED`. Cookie-authenticated writes must send the header `X-BP-Admin: 1` (CSRF protection); the browser also sends an `Origin` that must be on the allow-list.

post.summary: Upload a file and preview it (nothing is saved yet)
post.description:
Send the file as multipart form data (field `file`) with `?kind=COLLEGES` or `?kind=FEES`. The file is read and checked, and a preview of what saving would do is returned: counts, then every row with its action and a plain-words message. Nothing is changed in the catalogue until `POST /admin/imports/{id}/commit`. File-level problems (unreadable file, missing columns, too many rows) return 422 with `fields[0].path = "file"`.

**COLLEGES:** columns Country (or State for India colleges), College, City, and optionally Kind, Ownership, Established, Course length (months), Website, Teaching language, Intake, Internship months, Seats for Indians, MBBS seats, Hospital, Hospital beds, Verified, Note. New colleges are always drafts. Existing colleges are never overwritten, only empty fields are filled.

**FEES:** columns College (or Slug), Year, Tuition, Currency, and optionally Country/State (to tell apart same-named colleges), Hostel, Other, Source URL, Source, Checked on. A fee row replaces the stored one for that college and year. Requires role EDITOR or ADMIN. Writes need the `X-BP-Admin: 1` header.
